text: The mobile application crashes consistently whenever I attempt to upload more than three screenshot attachments.
We had an executive demonstration today and the main dashboard threw an internal 500 server error for 45 minutes.
CSV export is completely broken for date ranges extending beyond 30 days. The downloaded file is empty with 0 bytes.
Webhook signature verification fails intermittently on our production endpoints. The HMAC SHA256 header hash is invalid.
After changing team permissions in the settings panel, four of our project administrators were locked out with 403 Forbidden loops.
Single sign-on via Okta SAML assertion is throwing 502 Bad Gateway errors. None of our enterprise staff can sign in.
API response latencies surged to 12 seconds between 2 PM and 5 PM IST, causing request timeouts across our backend workers.
The billing system double charged our corporate credit card on yesterday's subscription renewal without generating a tax invoice.
Filtering by 'Last 90 days' resets immediately back to 'Today' whenever the browser tab is refreshed or reopened.
Push notifications on iOS are completely silent after the latest app release. We missed three critical customer escalations.
Database connection pool exhaustion errors appear in the logs whenever more than 40 team members view the dashboard at once.
Deleting a custom tag unexpectedly deleted 350 customer records permanently without displaying a confirmation dialog.
We lost two hours of feedback categorization work because the auto-save feature silently failed after a network blip.
Our scheduled Monday morning email report failed to generate, and our support ticket has received no reply for 48 hours.
Two-factor authentication SMS codes take 20 minutes to reach Indian mobile numbers on Jio and Airtel networks.
The web application threw an unhandled JavaScript exception 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined' on the triage table.
Audit trail logs show a missing event gap between 02:00 and 05:00 UTC yesterday, which breaches our compliance audit.
Our subscription cost increased by 35% without any prior notice, email notification, or transition timeline.
The bulk archive action wiped records without providing an undo notification. We have no way to restore our archived items.
Session tokens expire after only five minutes of inactivity despite the 'Keep me logged in' option being selected.
The dashboard fails to load entirely on Safari 17, showing only a blank white screen with console errors.
Exporting feedbacks with special characters in Hindi and Tamil results in garbled text with question marks in Excel.
Customer feedback submitted through the public link disappeared from the inbox without any trace or notification.
The payment gateway integration failed during our annual license upgrade, leaving our account in a suspended state.
Role assignment changes made by the workspace owner do not propagate to sub-accounts without manual backend intervention.
The search index is completely desynchronized. Newly added customer issues do not appear in queries even after 24 hours.
Memory leak in the real-time event listener crashes the browser tab after running for more than three hours continuously.
Custom webhook payload delivery dropped 40% of events during yesterday's traffic peak with no retry attempts logged.
Password reset links sent to our corporate Microsoft Outlook inboxes expire before they are delivered to users.
The attention panel threw a 504 Gateway Timeout when calculating churn risks for an organization with 10k items.

Please add an option to export summary reports directly to PDF with our corporate branding for stakeholder presentations.
A direct Slack and Discord webhook alert system for P0 and P1 customer feedback would greatly improve our response time.
Could you support multiple workspaces under a single company billing account so we can manage different product lines?
We need custom role-based access control (RBAC) so junior support reps have read-only access to feedback intelligence.
Please provide an undo toast notification with a 10-second grace window after deleting or archiving feedback items.
It would be beneficial if the AI executive summary automatically highlighted revenue churn risks and enterprise accounts.
Can we configure automated tag rules based on keyword patterns such as 'billing', 'refund', or 'downtime'?
Would appreciate true dark mode support with OLED blacks to reduce eye strain during evening on-call shifts.

Could you integrate Zapier and Make.com triggers whenever high-severity customer complaints are classified?
